en.description:
About Us

We are a dynamic, growing team in the Hospitality sector, dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to our clients, partners, and visitors. As the face and voice of our office, you will play a crucial role in shaping how the world perceives our brand from the moment they walk through our doors or call our line.

The Role

We are looking for a welcoming, organized, and proactive Front Office Employee to join our team. In this role, you will be the primary point of contact for all visitors and incoming communications. You will ensure the smooth, day-to-day operations of our front desk, combining top-tier customer service with essential administrative support.

If you are a people person who thrives in a vibrant environment and loves keeping things organized, we want to hear from you!

Your Responsibilities

  • First Class Hospitality: Greet and welcome visitors, clients, and candidates with warmth and professionalism, ensuring they are directed to the right person or meeting room.

  • Communication Hub: Answer, screen, and forward incoming phone calls, and handle the general company email inbox.

  • Logistics & Mail: Sort and distribute daily mail, deliveries, and couriers; prepare outgoing shipments and coordinate office supplies inventory.

  • Administrative Support: Assist various departments (such as HR or Finance) with light administrative tasks, data entry, scheduling meeting rooms, and organizing company events.

  • Security & Access: Monitor visitor logs and issue visitor badges to maintain a secure office environment.

Additional information

Salary: 60 000 euros per year.

en.description:
Are you a French speaker living in the Netherlands? We are looking for a Customer Support Specialist to lead our expansion into the French market. You will be the primary point of contact for our French-speaking users, ensuring they receive high-quality support while helping us adapt our service to the cultural nuances of the region.

Your Key Responsibilities:

  • Market Ownership: Act as the dedicated support lead for our French-speaking customers via email, chat, and phone.

  • Translation & Localization: Help localize support content, templates, and FAQ articles to ensure they resonate with the French market.

  • Problem Solving: Resolve technical, billing, or account inquiries with a focus on high first-contact resolution.

  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with our English-speaking product team to report bugs or user feedback specific to the French user experience.

en.description:
We are seeking a talented Demo Specialist to join our team in the Netherlands at a leading company that specializes in providing innovative HR, ATS, and Performance Management Software solutions. As a Demo Specialist, you will play a crucial role in showcasing the capabilities and features of our software to potential clients, helping them understand how our solutions can meet their specific needs and drive their business forward.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Conducting engaging and informative product demonstrations to prospective clients, highlighting the key functionalities and benefits of our HR, ATS, and Performance Management Software.

  • Understanding the unique requirements of each client and tailoring the demo presentations to address their specific needs and challenges.

  • Collaborating closely with the sales team to support the sales process and contribute to the overall success of the business.

  • Gathering feedback from clients during and after the demos to continuously improve the quality of presentations and better meet customer expectations.

  • Staying up-to-date with the latest features and updates of our software products to effectively communicate their value to potential clients.

If you are passionate about technology, have a knack for delivering compelling presentations, and enjoy working in a dynamic and innovative environment, we would love to hear from you. Join us in revolutionizing the HR and performance management landscape with our cutting-edge software solutions!
